title: Reduce today's load
action: Pick three tasks, defer the rest, and start the smallest high-priority action.
expectedBenefit: Reduces decision fatigue and creates visible progress.

title: Start a short focus block
action: Run a 25-minute focus session on one task before adding new work.

title: Close the loop with reflection
action: Write a short reflection and choose tomorrow's first action.
expectedBenefit: Improves planning quality for the next day.

title: Protect recovery before adding pressure
action: Cut the task list, finish one essential task, and schedule sleep or recovery.
expectedBenefit: Prevents false productivity while preserving consistency.
